title: Commit: test(atc-node): avoid sampled-height race in multi-node E2E
content:
test(atc-node): avoid sampled-height race in multi-node E2E

* test(atc-node): compare shared finalized block instead of sampled heights

* test(atc-node): wait for finality before comparing shared block

* fix(test): send newline in finality polling RPC

* fix(test): satisfy clippy after finalized-height assertion
